_comment: RecommendationRun forward pipeline. Realized as a pure transition function in pf.domain; the run loop runs in pf.app. Single writer: the one process that started the run drives it to a terminal state, so no optimistic-lock overlay is needed on the run itself. The flaky dependency is the market-data provider, handled by the collectRetry overlay (bounded retry of the fetch) and, at the feed layer, the MarketDataFeed circuit breaker. This graph is the modeled envelope for driver-delivered RESOLVED invoke outcomes: pre-run repository admission failures create no run and consume no retries, and durable Ready/Failed additionally require a confirmed atomic publication receipt outside this graph.

_delays.FETCH_TIMEOUT: 20000 ms - per-attempt result-admission deadline for collecting price history for the whole candidate universe; an accepted result stays accepted even if its delivery is late
_delays.OPTIMIZE_TIMEOUT: 60000 ms - result-admission deadline bounding acceptance of the optimizer's computed 16-of-N min-drawdown result; final repository publication carries its own separate 5000 ms store-write admission budget
_delays.RETRY_BACKOFF: ~1000 ms exponential backoff between price-fetch retries

_counters.retries: one budget per recommendation-run instance: the recommend command creates one run, drives it once from Collecting to Ready or Failed, and never resumes a terminal instance; a re-issued command creates a new run with retries initialized to zero. The counter governs the modeled retry loop over accepted feed outcomes only
